review.tagline: Coding-agent skill that runs a multi-phase security audit of a codebase
review.summary: A skill for coding agents that audits a repository for vulnerabilities in six phases: reconnaissance, hunting, candidate validation, structured output, record verification and reporting. Isolated sub-agents hunt from a coverage ledger, and a fresh agent tries to disprove each candidate. Results go to findings.json, checked by Node validators, and to REPORT.md. It is the single-repo starting point for Cloudflare's vulnerability harness.
review.audience: Security engineers and developers auditing code with a coding agent
strengths: Separate agents find and validate each finding; verdicts are confirmed, needs_validation or rejected
Zero-dependency Node validators check findings.json and coverage-ledger.json against a schema
Attack-class prompts cover memory safety, web/auth, cloud, supply chain, client-side and LLM targets
Repeated runs reuse prior ledgers and findings to target coverage gaps
weaknesses: Needs a model with tool use and parallel sub-agents; token cost is unknown
Running target code requires an OS-enforced sandbox you must provide, else leads stay unvalidated
README says a single run found roughly half of what repeated runs found
No release published; install goes through the Skills CLI via npx
needs: Needs Node.js, Skills CLI (npx skills), coding agent with parallel sub-agents, OS-enforced sandbox
Models: any tool-use model with parallel sub-agents
